core_aesthetic_archetype: Warm Editorial Bookstore (Cream Paper & Rich Ink)
emotional_tone: Inviting, literary, tactile, calm, intellectual sanctuary

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Instrument Sans, sans-serif

text_hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium leading-[1.1]
text_hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium leading-snug
text_hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-stone-500

layout_and_grids.hero_grid_mode: Tetris Asymmetric: 12-column grid with featured curated volume on the left (7 cols) and warm bookstack storytelling with reading metrics on right (5 cols)
layout_and_grids.catalog_layout: Sidebar filter (col-span-12 lg:col-span-3) + Book Grid (col-span-12 lg:col-span-9 grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6)
layout_and_grids.book_card_aspect_ratio: Book jackets in crisp vertical proportions (approx 2:3 or 3:4) with spine shadow illusion and subtle deckled edge effect
layout_and_grids.cart_drawer: Side slide-over sheet or dedicated clean review view with line items, quantity steppers, subtotal, shipping calculation ($0 demo indicator), and instant demo checkout trigger
layout_and_grids.checkout_modal_or_view: Clearly labeled 'Demo Bookstore Checkout' with 2-step simulated flow: Shipping Address + Payment Simulation ('No real card charged') + Order Confirmation Receipt with simulated tracking and book quote

component_hierarchy.name: NavigationHeader
component_hierarchy.description: Editorial navigation bar with BookNest logo (serif), category quick-links, live search bar with keyboard shortcut, and Cart trigger button displaying dynamic item counter.

component_hierarchy.name: HeroCuratorSpotlight
component_hierarchy.description: Warm bookstore mood piece featuring 'Book of the Month', editorial excerpt, author signature typography, star reviews, and immediate 'Read Excerpt' / 'Add to Cart' actions.

component_hierarchy.name: CatalogFilterBar
component_hierarchy.description: Category pills ('All Books', 'Fiction & Literature', 'Philosophy & Mind', 'Design & Architecture', 'Poetry', 'Culinary & Living', 'History'), search refinement, price sorting, and instant availability toggles.

component_hierarchy.name: BookCard
component_hierarchy.description: Tactile editorial book card displaying cover artwork with realistic drop shadow, title in serif, author name, category tag, rating, price formatted in USD, and 'Quick View' + 'Add to Cart' buttons.

component_hierarchy.name: BookDetailModal
component_hierarchy.description: Deep-dive reader drawer/dialog with large cover illustration, full blurb, ISBN, page count, publication year, editorial review quote, format selector (Hardcover, Paperback, Collector's Cloth), quantity control, and Add to Cart.

component_hierarchy.name: CartDrawer
component_hierarchy.description: Off-canvas sliding cart showing items, quantity increment/decrement, remove item, subtotal summary, and prominent 'Proceed to Demo Checkout' action.

component_hierarchy.name: DemoCheckoutFlow
component_hierarchy.description: A polished, explicitly stated 'Demo Checkout (No real payment)' modal with prefill button for quick testing, shipping address input, payment method simulation (Credit Card / Bookstore Gift Card), order summary, and place order button.

component_hierarchy.name: OrderConfirmationReceipt
component_hierarchy.description: Warm vintage invoice-style receipt with simulated Order #BN-XXXXX, delivery estimate, order items list, total paid ($0.00 demo or simulated total), celebratory confetti/reading quote, and 'Return to Library' button.

seeded_catalog_data.title: The Architecture of Silence
seeded_catalog_data.author: Elena Rostova
seeded_catalog_data.description: A quiet investigation into spaces designed for contemplation, monastic aesthetics, and the restorative power of empty rooms in modern metropolitan sprawl.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: To build silence is to build an altar for the human spirit.

seeded_catalog_data.title: Letters to a Wild Pear Tree
seeded_catalog_data.author: Julian Vance
seeded_catalog_data.description: Lyrical prose poems meditating on seasonal solitude, Mediterranean orchard landscapes, and the lingering echoes of lost correspondences.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: Autumn arrives like an unwritten letter slipped beneath the door.

seeded_catalog_data.title: Pride & Prejudices: The Peacock Edition
seeded_catalog_data.author: Jane Austen
seeded_catalog_data.description: A breathtaking heritage binding of Austen’s beloved masterpiece with gold foil feather stampings and archival ribbon bookmark.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: There is a stubbornness about me that never can bear to be frightened at the will of others.

seeded_catalog_data.title: The First New Universe
seeded_catalog_data.author: Dr. Miriam Thorne
seeded_catalog_data.description: Exploring quantum ontology, cosmology, and the poetic imagination required to contemplate dimensions beyond human senses.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: The cosmos is not merely stranger than we imagine; it is stranger than we are equipped to desire.

seeded_catalog_data.title: The Memory of Leaves
seeded_catalog_data.author: Carlos Zafón
seeded_catalog_data.description: Set in misty Barcelona courtyards, an antiquarian bookseller stumbles upon a cursed manuscript that alters the past of those who read it.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: Books are mirrors: you only see in them what you already have inside you.

seeded_catalog_data.title: Botanical Tables & Feasts
seeded_catalog_data.author: Camille Dupré
seeded_catalog_data.description: Wild fermentation, edible floriculture, and intimate candlelit dinners through the four seasons in the French countryside.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: A meal shared among books is nourishment twice blessed.

seeded_catalog_data.title: The Lost Cartographies
seeded_catalog_data.author: Sterling Hayes
seeded_catalog_data.description: The forgotten maritime charts of the Indian Ocean and the navigators who drew mythic sea beasts where the abyss begins.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: Every boundary on a map is a monument to human longing.

seeded_catalog_data.title: Meditations in the Dusk
seeded_catalog_data.author: Arthur St. Claire
seeded_catalog_data.description: Quiet philosophical essays on slowing down in an accelerationist society, cultivating private gardens, and the craft of re-reading.
seeded_catalog_data.quote: The book you open in sorrow will speak to you in a voice the joyful never hear.

motion_and_interactions.book_card_hover: transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-0.5deg); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease;
motion_and_interactions.cart_drawer_animation: slide in from right using Tailwind transform translate-x-0 with subtle parchment backdrop blur
motion_and_interactions.toast_feedback: Use Sonner toast with warm cream background, stone border, and custom book bookmark icon for 'Added to your book satchel'
motion_and_interactions.filter_transitions: Smooth fade and scale with CSS opacity/transform (0.2s ease-out)

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Warm Editorial bookstore atmosphere: Cream paper tones (#FAF7F2), deep charcoal ink (#1C1917), terracotta/amber accents (#B45309). Avoid generic purple gradients or stark AI neon.
No full-screen dark gradients. Light theme with tactile paper textures and warm parchment borders.
Every book card MUST feature crisp typography, rating stars, price, category pill, and quick add-to-cart with immediate feedback.
Search input must support instantaneous client-side filtering across book title, author, and description with clean highlight or counter.
Demo checkout MUST be clearly branded with a disclaimer pill: 'Demo Mode — No real charges will be made'. Provide a 1-click 'Prefill Demo Data' button to make testing frictionless for the user.
Order confirmation screen must simulate a printed vintage bookstore receipt with order number, estimated reading delivery, item list, and return to catalog button.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes conforming to role-based kebab-case naming.
Responsive navigation with mobile drawer and desktop quick links. Cart count badge updates automatically in header with pulse animation.
